## Purpose

What user or engineering problem does this change solve?

## Design-system impact

- [ ] No brand-anchor change
- [ ] Token/recipe change explained
- [ ] Any exception to Anti-AI-Slop is named and justified
- [ ] No new visual or styling dependency without review

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Keyboard and visible focus checked
- [ ] Arabic RTL checked
- [ ] English LTR checked
- [ ] Narrow and wide responsive states checked
- [ ] Contrast and reduced motion checked where relevant


## Document-system impact (when applicable)

- [ ] Content and project profile validate against the committed JSON Schemas
- [ ] `npm run check:documents` passes
- [ ] Real artifacts for all affected formats were generated and structurally checked
- [ ] `npm run docs:visual-check -- .test-artifacts/documents` passes where system render tools are available
- [ ] Arabic RTL, mixed Arabic/Latin strings, English LTR, tables, and long content are covered
- [ ] CI preview images were inspected, or human visual review is explicitly marked PARTIAL
- [ ] PDF font licensing and Arabic glyph coverage have been reviewed when relevant

## Evidence and limitations

Link screenshots, recordings, test output, or measurements that actually exist. State what was not tested; do not claim unverified checks passed.
